schur_low_frequency: Gamma_eff = Gamma_x + C K^-1 D K^-1 C^T
passivity_condition: K positive definite, D positive semidefinite, Gamma_x positive semidefinite
c3_isotropy: Gamma_eff = gamma(L) I_2, for symmetric invariant response
single_plane: gamma=gamma_0+c^2 d/k^2; gamma_prime=gamma_0_prime+(c^2 d/k^2)(2 c_prime/c+d_prime/d-2 k_prime/k)
identifiability: all nonnegative bath values and every local load-derivative sign are possible under same geometry and symmetry
verification: exact rational scalar Schur and derivative checks; numerical noncommuting matrix derivative check; manuscript integration text assertions
source: Chen et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 166201 (2026), DOI 10.1103/ly48-b4l2, public abstract
